name: flux-agent
displayName: Flux Agent — drive flux as a sub-agent
description: Dispatch work to the flux agent (codewandler/flux) over its NDJSON line protocol instead of scraping rendered prose. Ships a skill teaching the trust rules for an unattended flux run — the exit code and a clean `turn_end` both lie when a turn dies on a provider error — plus a wrapper script that classifies transport vs task failures, resumes transport failures with bounded backoff, stops on a repeating deterministic failure, and verifies completion against a caller-supplied ground-truth predicate.
